verdicts.reason: A: clear center headline with the CTA at the right reads left to right, but the date block on the left is crowded against the logo, the subtitle wraps to an orphan line ("of the year"), the RSVP sits apart from its URL in the center, and the missing-asset placeholder collides with the bottom-right corner. B: the CTA has shrunk to a pill no bigger than the tag pills, so it is buried among them. The headline is cramped into the lower left, the subtitle is squeezed into a narrow column, and the date heading sits far above its own detail line. The small text (URL, legal) is scattered in tiny fragments, the logo is clipped by the planet edge, and the placeholder is crammed in.
